observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Runtime metrics, query analysis, and N+1 detection
observability.noN1Patterns: No suspected N+1 patterns in the retained sample.
observability.staleData: Showing the last successful snapshot. Refresh to try again.
observability.sampleWindow: {count} of the latest {capacity} queries retained by this API process. This sample is held in memory and resets on restart.
observability.sampleCount: {count} queries in the current process sample. These are not lifetime totals.
observability.showingQueries: Showing the latest {count} of {total} retained queries.
observability.n1Explanation: At least {count} successful reads of the same SQL pattern in one request. Review the caller for repeated lookups and consider eager loading or a batch query. Repetition alone does not confirm an N+1 problem.
observability.legacyN1Explanation: This API returns repeated patterns without request-level detection metadata. They may span unrelated requests and do not confirm an N+1 problem.

serverDetail.deleteDescription: Delete "{name}"? This action cannot be undone.
serverDetail.deleteCustomImpact: This removes the server record from Launchctl. The machine, its files, and installed services remain running. Remove them manually if needed.
serverDetail.deleteCloudImpact: This requests deletion of the cloud provider instance and its data. Deletion runs in the background. The server record is kept if provider deletion fails.
serverDetail.uninstallOfflineImpact: If Launchctl cannot connect, it removes the server, its sites, and its Docker projects from Launchctl. The machine and its workloads stay in place.
serverDetail.removedOffline: Server unreachable. Launchctl removed its server, site, and project records. The machine remains in place.
serverDetail.deleteBusy: Deletion is unavailable while the server is starting, provisioning, or being deleted.
serverDetail.deleteSites: Uninstalling a reachable server requires removing its {count} site(s) first.
serverDetail.deleteProjects: Uninstalling a reachable server requires removing its {count} Docker project(s) first.
serverDetail.deleteHelp: Type the server name to confirm deletion:
serverDetail.deleteProviderUnauthorized: The cloud provider rejected the saved credentials. Update the provider connection and try again.
serverDetail.deleteProviderForbidden: The cloud provider denied deletion. Check the connection permissions and try again.
serverDetail.removeRecordDescription: Remove "{name}" from launchctl? This action cannot be undone.
serverDetail.removeRecordImpact: Removes this server, its sites, and its Docker projects from Launchctl. The machine, its files, running workloads, and any provider billing stay in place.
serverDetail.removeRecordHelp: Type the server name to confirm removing its launchctl record:
serverDetail.removeRecordFailed: Failed to remove the server from launchctl

siteDetail.title: Site details
siteDetail.unavailable: This site is no longer available.

userDetail.deleteDescription: This permanently removes the account and its owned teams and resources from Launchctl.
userDetail.acknowledgeBilling: I’ve reviewed the billing warning and want to permanently delete this account.
userDetail.deletePaidOrder: This customer has a paid order. Subscription cancellation and payment refunds are handled separately.
userDetail.deletePaidSubscription: This customer has a current or past paid subscription. Subscription cancellation and payment refunds are handled separately.
userDetail.deleteBillingChanged: Billing history changed. Open Delete user again to review the warning.
userDetail.noTeams: This user does not own any teams.
userDetail.noServers: This user does not own any servers.
userDetail.noSites: This user does not have any sites.
userDetail.staffAccessDescription: Controls access to the admin panel. Team permissions are managed separately.
userDetail.selfRoleGuard: You cannot change your own staff role.
userDetail.grantStaffWarning: This grants platform-wide staff access for the selected role. Team permissions are unchanged.
userDetail.removeStaffWarning: This removes access to the admin panel. The user keeps their team permissions.
userDetail.demoteBeforeDelete: Change staff access to Regular user before deleting this user.
userDetail.siteDeletionPendingHelp: Site cleanup runs in the background. This list updates automatically after changes and when the live connection reconnects. The row remains until deletion completes.
userDetail.siteDeletionFailed: Could not uninstall the site. Check the server connection or remove the site from Launchctl.
userDetail.deleteSiteDescription: Remove {address} from Launchctl to leave it running on {server}, or uninstall it to delete its files, web configuration, and queue workers in the background.
userDetail.deleteSiteHelp: Type the site domain to confirm deletion:
userDetail.siteRemovalFailed: Could not remove the site from Launchctl
